name: Black Sabbath

whyMatters.en: Birmingham four-piece formed in 1968. The 1970 debut and Paranoid fixed tritone riffs, down-tuned guitar, and occult-tinged lyrics as a heavy sound distinct from blues-based hard rock.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰四人组，1968 年成立。1970 年首专与《Paranoid》确立三全音 riff、降调吉他与偏神秘歌词，形成相对蓝调 hard rock 更可分离的重金属声音。

note.en: Title track from the 1970 debut; tritone riff and slow tempo.
note.zh: 1970 年首专同名曲；三全音 riff 与慢速度。

note.en: Short, faster single from Paranoid; still suited to radio length.
note.zh: 出自《Paranoid》的短快单曲；时长仍适合电台。

interviewQuotes.text: We knew we had something different.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Tony Iommi

interviewQuotes.text: The tritone was the devil's interval. We just made it a riff.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Geezer Butler

lyricQuotes: What is this that stands before me?
Iron man / Has won the war

shortBio.en: Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward; Paranoid-era foundation for heavy metal.
shortBio.zh: Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward；《Paranoid》时期为重金属奠基。

body.en:
Black Sabbath formed in Birmingham in 1968. Black Sabbath, Paranoid, and Master of Reality document Tony Iommi’s riff writing after a fingertip injury (lighter strings and fretting adaptations), Geezer Butler’s bass and lyrics, Ozzy Osbourne’s nasal lead, and Bill Ward’s drums.

The title track Black Sabbath (1970) plus Paranoid and Iron Man are the usual early reference set. After Ozzy left in 1979, Ronnie James Dio joined for Heaven and Hell (1980)—same band name, different singer and lyric approach.
body.zh:
Black Sabbath 于 1968 年在伯明翰成立。《Black Sabbath》、《Paranoid》与《Master of Reality》记录 Tony Iommi 指伤后的 riff 写法（更细弦、按弦适应）、Geezer Butler 的贝斯与歌词、Ozzy Osbourne 的鼻音主唱，以及 Bill Ward 的鼓。

同名曲《Black Sabbath》（1970）与《Paranoid》《Iron Man》是早期常用参照。1979 年 Ozzy 离队后，Ronnie James Dio 加入并录制《Heaven and Hell》（1980）——同名乐队，主唱与歌词取向不同。

body.en:
Sabbath’s early weight comes from arrangement choices: tritone intervals, slow tempos, and bleak lyrics—not only louder amplifiers.

That writing separates more clearly from blues-based hard rock of the same years.

The 1970–71 albums are the usual citation for early heavy metal.
body.zh:
Sabbath 早期的「重」来自编曲选择：三全音、慢速度与阴郁歌词——不只是更大的音箱。

这套写法相对同期蓝调 hard rock 更容易区分。

1970–71 年专辑是早期重金属的常用参照。

title.zh: Ozzy 年代与 Dio 年代

body.en:
The Ozzy-era peak is the founding citation: 1968–1979 with Iommi, Butler, and Ward.

Dio’s Heaven and Hell (1980) keeps Iommi’s riff writing and changes the vocal and fantasy lyric.

Same name, different singer—why lineup versions are listed separately.
body.zh:
Ozzy 时期巅峰是创始参照：1968–1979，与 Iommi、Butler、Ward 同台。

Dio 的《Heaven and Hell》（1980）保留 Iommi 的 riff 写法，更换人声与奇幻歌词。

同名、不同主唱——故阵容版本分开列出。

body.en:
Rain and bell sounds lead into Iommi’s tritone figure; Ozzy’s vocal enters over a slow tempo.

Often cited as an early metal reference track. The atmosphere comes from tempo and interval, not stage effects alone.
body.zh:
雨声与钟声引入 Iommi 的三全音音型；Ozzy 人声进入慢速度。

常被引为早期金属参照曲。氛围来自速度与音程，不只是舞台效果。

body.en:
Faster riff and shorter runtime than the title track, still heavy and down-tuned.

It fits AM/FM length while keeping the early Sabbath guitar tone.

Useful contrast to the slower crawl of Black Sabbath.
body.zh:
riff 更快、时长更短，仍保持降调与重量。

适合 AM/FM 时长，同时保留早期 Sabbath 吉他音色。

可与同名曲的慢速形成对照。

body.en:
Doom keeps the slow dread. NWOBHM keeps riff primacy at higher speed. Seattle grunge cites the heavy low end more than the occult lyric.

Influence here is catalog and arrangement, not imagery for its own sake.
body.zh:
Doom 留下慢与阴郁。NWOBHM 以更高速度保持 riff 优先。西雅图 grunge 更多引用偏重的低频，而非神秘学歌词。

此处影响指向曲目与编曲，而非为意象而意象。

body.en:
Early press language often lagged behind the later genre label.

Useful quotes describe volume, gloom, and audience reaction; the name heavy metal arrives more clearly in retrospect.

Track that naming lag as part of the history.
body.zh:
早期媒体用语常落后于后来的类型标签。

有用的引语描述音量、阴郁与听众反应；heavy metal 这一名称更多是事后明确的。

把命名滞后当作历史的一部分追踪。

note.zh: 创始 Ozzy 时期巅峰阵容。

note.en: Same band name; Dio on vocals for Heaven and Hell and related albums.
note.zh: 同名乐队；Dio 主唱《Heaven and Hell》及相关专辑。

note.en: Tritone opening; early metal reference track.
note.zh: 三全音开场；早期金属参照曲。

note.en: Heaviness from interval, tempo, and lyric frame—not volume alone.
note.zh: 「重」来自音程、速度与歌词框架——不只是音量。
